name: What?
summary: Party game where players write funny answers to prompts and others guess who wrote the favorite answer.
rules_text: Play 15 rounds with 5-17 players. Each round one player is questioner: draw a What card and read the question for that round number, or choose favorite on choice rounds. All players including questioner secretly write a funny response on their answer sheet. Sheets go to questioner who reads all answers aloud hiding names. Questioner picks one favorite answer (cannot pick duplicate text). Clockwise from left of questioner, each other player guesses aloud who authored the chosen answer, debating and bluffing but not guessing themselves. After guesses, author is revealed: each correct guesser scores 1. If no one correct, author scores 3, or 1 if author is the questioner. Questioner rotates, scoring sheet passed. Most points after 15 rounds wins.
rating_reason: Party guessing who wrote what, bluffing with free text, fits engine
